title: Tandem Queues with Hybrid Abandonment in Heavy Traffic
summary: Hybrid-abandonment systems, where jobs abandon from certain stages of service but not others, occur frequently in medical, service, and computing systems. Abandonment affects the heavy-traffic behavior of both the stages with and without abandonment. In contrast to existing heavy-traffic works that focus on cases where there is abandonment at either all stages or no stages, we focus on the heavy-traffic behavior for these hybrid-abandonment systems. We provide the first heavy-traffic characterization of the second queue length in a two-stage tandem queue with abandonment only in the first…
